title: Kissing number in dimension 27, lower bound
statement: Find as many nonzero vectors as possible in R^27 with pairwise angles of at least 60 degrees; k such vectors show that the kissing number in dimension 27 is at least k. The best known configuration, by A. Kravatskiy (2026), has 209825 vectors; one with more vectors improves it. The upper bound is 522212 (Leijenhorst and de Laat).
submission: Text file: one vector per line, integer coordinates separated by spaces or commas, all with the same squared norm N; more than 27 coordinates are allowed when the vectors span a space of dimension at most 27. Every inner product between two vectors must be at most N/2. With 209,825 vectors or more the check is long (hours) in pure Python.
score: k, the number of vectors (larger is better)

best_known.source: kissing number in dimension 27 >= 209825: A. Kravatskiy (2026), in Henry Cohn's table of kissing numbers (cohn.mit.edu/kissing-numbers); read 9 Nov 2026

bound.source: N. Leijenhorst and D. de Laat (2022), in Henry Cohn's table
